title: Nutty Earthy Italian Shrimp Lasagna
description: This dish is an earthy and romantic Italian lasagna featuring shrimp paste and kapi, with a nutty flavor, diabetic friendly and made in the style of Emilia-Romagna cuisine, it has a smoky wok hei flavor.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a wok, heat the olive oil and add the garlic, mushrooms, and spinach, stir frying until the vegetables are tender.
Add the shrimp paste to the wok and stir fry for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, shrimp paste mixture, and almond flour.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the noodle mixture.
Top the noodle layer with a layer of parmesan cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the lasagna in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before serving.
